contract.intent: Render the Drift contract context for a target file: the contracts anchored on it and the contracts that declare it as a source of truth, so an agent sees everything a change to that file can break — derived from the file, never predicted.

must_not_change: File context must cover the contracts anchored on the requested file AND the contracts that declare it as an SSOT.
Context must never be predicted from a task prompt; it is derived only from the requested file.
SSOT candidate resolution must reuse contract-paths, never a local re-implementation.
